# Setupr

> Setupr is a global digital services platform for founders. We sit in the gap that makes a business legit and modern: business registration, custom websites, feature integrations (WhatsApp, payments, CRM), and workflow automations. One team, done for you.

Setupr helps founders worldwide launch and scale. Our pillars are:
1. Business registration and formation.
2. Custom websites and digital presence.
3. Feature integrations: WhatsApp Business, payment gateways, CRM, email, analytics.
4. Automations and AI: workflow automation, AI agents, chatbots, and tool onboarding.

We also run a cloud software marketplace for Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Adobe, AWS, and Zoho. India-specific services (GST, MSME, PAN, trademark, Indian company types) remain available on request.
